title.narrative: Advancing Ethical AI and Inclusive Digital Transformation in East Asia

description.narrative:
This workplan will support Member States and stakeholders in East Asia to promote the ethical development and application of AI in public and private spheres, with a focus on inclusive, accessible and gender-responsive digital transformation.
The work will strengthen practical AI literacy, responsible AI use, digital inclusion, employability and entrepreneurship opportunities for groups at risk of exclusion, particularly women with disabilities, caregiver women, youth with disabilities, and educators working with learners with disabilities or special learning needs.
In Mongolia, activities may include needs assessment, accessible curriculum development, practical AI skills training, mentoring, follow-up support, and documentation of lessons for future replication. In China, the work may engage academic, disability, education and technology partners to exchange experience on inclusive digital participation, accessibility, gender-responsive AI skills and responsible AI use. Regional knowledge-sharing may be explored where relevant.
